query:
UPDATE transaction_submissions

        SET
            status = $2,

            confirmed_slot = CASE
                WHEN $3::BOOLEAN THEN $4::BIGINT
                ELSE confirmed_slot
            END,

            observed_commitment = CASE
                WHEN $3::BOOLEAN THEN 'finalized'
                ELSE observed_commitment
            END,

            confirmed_at = CASE
                WHEN $3::BOOLEAN
                    THEN COALESCE(confirmed_at, now())
                ELSE confirmed_at
            END,

            finalized_at = CASE
                WHEN $3::BOOLEAN THEN now()
                ELSE finalized_at
            END,

            failed_at = now(),
            last_checked_at = now(),

            error_code = $5,
            error_message = $6

        WHERE submission_id = $1
        AND (
                (
                    $3::BOOLEAN = TRUE
                    AND status IN (
                        'submitted',
                        'unknown',
                        'confirmed'
                    )
                )
                OR
                (
                    $3::BOOLEAN = FALSE
                    AND status IN (
                        'submitted',
                        'unknown'
                    )
                )
        )
        RETURNING submission_id
